page_title: LYO 1-0 ANG | Lyon v Angers 19/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+6' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is in the right place at the right time to meet a rebound and attempts a header towards the bottom right corner. Dominik Greif is alert and denies him with a quick save.
90+5' The ball goes out of play. Angers are awarded a corner kick.

90+5' Lanroy Machine (Angers) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and unleashes a snap shot directed into the top left corner, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save.
90+2' Substitution. Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) in, Adam Karabec out.
90+2' That's the end of the game for Malick Fofana, who is replaced by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
90+1' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lyon.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Here is a change. Lilian Raolisoa is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Lanroy Machine (Angers).
89' Clinton Mata (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' The ball is out of play. Angers win a corner kick.
86' Angers players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
85' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 66:34.
83' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Adam Karabec (Lyon) sends it out of play.
83' Malick Fofana (Lyon) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Herve Koffi easily makes the save.
81' The substitution has been made. Pierrick Capelle (Angers) has replaced Yassine Belkhdim.
81' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Enzo Molebe (Lyon) replaces Martin Satriano.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) comes onto the pitch for Corentin Tolisso.
80' Prosper Peter (Angers) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

79' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post.
76' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
76' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
74' A cross from Jacques Ekomie (Angers) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Angers will have a throw-in.

73' Angers slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
72' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
71' Martin Satriano (Lyon) looks on in disbelief after missing his chance. He fires the rebound onto the right post!
71' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
69' The ball goes out of play. Angers are awarded a corner kick.
66' 1 - 0 Goal! Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
65' Adam Karabec (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
65' Substitution. Pavel Sulc (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Khalis Merah walks off.
62' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Justin-Noel Kalumba is replaced by Sidiki Cherif (Angers).
62' Substitution. Louis Mouton makes way for Himad Abdelli (Angers).
61' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Martin Satriano (Lyon). Clement Turpin saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
59' Lyon hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
57' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:0.
54' Malick Fofana (Lyon) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
53' Khalis Merah (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
52' Adam Karabec (Lyon) will deliver the corner kick.
52' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Adam Karabec (Lyon) took the corner.
52' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Herve Koffi makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
50' The ball possession at the moment is 72:28.
48' The Lyon players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The foul by Adam Karabec (Lyon) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Angers enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
42' Malick Fofana (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

40' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
37' Carlens Arcus (Angers) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
37' Adam Karabec (Lyon) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
36' Adam Karabec (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Adam Karabec (Lyon) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
31' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) commits a foul and Clement Turpin immediately signals a free kick.
31' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
29' Decent spell from Angers here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. It's a throw-in for Angers.
26' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
26' Fouls committed – 5:3.
24' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Clinton Mata (Lyon) and blew his whistle.
23' Angers are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
21' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
21' Lyon will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Lefort (Angers) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' Malick Fofana (Lyon) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
19' Malick Fofana (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
16' The game is pretty dull as Angers are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.

15' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
14' The percentage of ball possession is – 89:11.
12' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
8' Carlens Arcus (Angers) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle.
8' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
6' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
5' Malick Fofana (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
5' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Jacques Ekomie (Angers) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
5' Lyon are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Adam Karabec (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lyon will kick the game off.
